## S12 Studio (simulator edition, beta)

**Download:** Windows `S12Studio-*-win-x64-setup.exe` · macOS `S12Studio-*-mac-arm64.dmg` (Apple Silicon) or `S12Studio-*-mac-x64.dmg` (Intel) · Linux `S12Studio-*-linux-x86_64.AppImage`. (The `.zip`, `.yml` and `.blockmap` files are for automatic updates.)
Install guide (the beta is not code-signed, so Windows and macOS warn on first launch): https://bigpowder1.github.io/s12studio/install.html

**ME 3305 labs:** copy the `blank_project` folder your course gives you, then File > Open... its `.mcp`. S12 Studio contains no course material (library or template); they come with your course's project folder. No project yet? Help > Open Demo Project.

- Simulator only: the real lab board (P&E Multilink) is not supported yet. macOS stays simulator-only.
